2607.28079.title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Informed Framework for Trustworthy Chemical Property Prediction
2607.28079.paper_summary: Chemical property prediction plays a critical role in accelerating scientific discovery in chemistry, materials science, and drug development. However, existing benchmarks often suffer from limited task diversity, fragmented datasets, and inconsistent evaluation protocols, making it challenging to systematically assess the reliability and generalization of AI models. In this work, we introduce Chem World, a comprehensive benchmark for chemical property prediction that integrates 17 diverse chemical datasets with over 800,000 molecular samples, covering various properties including density, electrical conductivity, solubility, and other molecular characteristics. Chem World provides a unified platform for evaluating AI models across multiple property prediction tasks. Furthermore, we propose Mixture-PINN, a physics-informed neural network based prediction framework that incorporates chemical prior knowledge into data-driven learning, improving the accuracy, robustness, and reliability of chemical property prediction. Extensive experiments on Chem World demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared with existing methods. By combining large-scale standardized evaluation with physics-informed learning, Chem World establishes a foundation for developing trustworthy AI systems for computational chemistry and advancing AI-driven scientific discovery.
2607.28079.paper_summary_zh: 化學性質預測在加速化學、材料科學和藥物開發中的科學發現中扮演著關鍵角色。<lb/>然而，現有的基準往往受到任務多樣性有限、數據集碎片化和評估協議不一致的影響，使得系統性評估AI模型的可靠性和泛化能力變得具有挑戰性。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了Chem World，一個綜合性的化學性質預測基準，整合了17個多樣化的化學數據集，包含超過800,000個分子樣本，涵蓋各種性質，包括密度、電導率、溶解度和其他分子特徵。<lb/>Chem World提供了一個統一的平台，用於評估AI模型在多個性質預測任務中的表現。<lb/>此外，我們提出了Mixture-PINN，一個基於物理知識的神經網絡預測框架，將化學先驗知識納入數據驅動學習中，提高了化學性質預測的準確性、穩健性和可靠性。<lb/>在Chem World上進行的廣泛實驗展示了我們的方法與現有方法相比的有效性。<lb/>通過結合大規模標準化評估與物理知識驅動的學習，Chem World為開發可靠的計算化學AI系統和推進AI驅動的科學發現奠定了基礎。
